name: Hollehesh
title: Descendant of Judah
summary: Hollehesh was one of the leaders in Judah who helped seal the covenant with God during Nehemiah's time. He is mentioned in the book of Nehemiah as one of those who put their seal on the written agreement to follow God's law after returning from exile in Babylon.

keyEvents.title: Sealing of the Covenant
keyEvents.description: Hollehesh was among the leaders of the people who sealed the covenant to follow God's law and commands after returning from exile.

keyEvents.title: Rebuilding Jerusalem's Wall
keyEvents.description: Hollehesh, who was leader over half of the Jerusalem district, helped repair Jerusalem's wall together with his daughter.

keyEvents.title: The People Renew the Covenant
keyEvents.description: As part of the people's renewal of the covenant, Hollehesh joined other leaders in committing to follow the Law of Moses and avoid intermarriage and Sabbath violations.

keyEvents.title: Nehemiah's Reforms
keyEvents.description: Hollehesh supported Nehemiah's reform work aimed at restoring proper worship and social life in rebuilt Jerusalem.
